scope.method: Text sweep across all 51 source files, targeted static code comparison, existing 12-case fatal-seal P1/P2 test, and four isolated multiplier P1/P2 battle probes. This is not exhaustive battle acceptance for all elves.
scope.applicationChanges: Audit report and ignored diagnostic files only. No gameplay descriptions, mechanics, private saves, desktop release, commits, or branch changes.

source.file: D:\影片\新增資料夾\elf_source_files\elf_files\晻藹夜靈.布萊克.txt
source.quote: >>>>雙方每處於1種異常狀態則上述提升非真實傷害效果翻倍10次

blackFindings.finding: Existing source snapshot is stale. The operation computes doubles=min(10,statusCount), boost=1.6*2^doubles, reduce=min(1,0.8*2^doubles). This differs from ten doublings per status and repeated 80% damage reduction. For repeated reduction, the literal source reading retains 0.2^(1+10*n) of non-true damage before integer rounding.
blackFindings.evidence: src/data/darkBlakeSoulKit.ts:17; src/blocks/ops/linkedTeam.ts:403; isolated P1/P2 battle probe: 1000 fixed damage loses 200 with no status, 0 with one status; boost log changes 160% to 320%.

blackFindings.finding: Negative-HP survival, including god descent, is explicitly excluded from both triggering and disabling the survival rule. It follows its negative death line but never consumes this seal through crossing zero. Whether a negative-HP survival rule itself should count as triggering at its activation point needs a precise event definition; current exception is hard coded and is not implied by the expanded source category.
blackFindings.evidence: src/battle/fatalHold.ts:80-89; tests/fatalSealCarried.semantic.test.ts:58-69 explicitly expects armed/spent flags unchanged for god descent. Existing 12-case P1/P2 test passed, proving old expectations, not the new source semantics.

source.file: D:\影片\新增資料夾\elf_source_files\elf_files\虯螭淵玄.索蘭特.txt

otherTextQuestions.uncertainty: Literal setting to 200 differs from capping at 200. If the opponent shield is 100, should it rise to 200? How should the stated difference cost be handled in that case?

source.file: D:\影片\新增資料夾\elf_source_files\elf_files\魔化.瑞爾斯.txt
source.quote: >每造成對手最大體力1%的傷害則額外吸取對手1%體力

otherTextQuestions.uncertainty: The extra 1% HP does not specify current versus maximum HP. Do incomplete 1% damage segments accumulate across hits?
otherTextQuestions.implementation: Uses opponent maximum HP, floors segment count per individual damage event, and settles each extra 1% separately.

source.quote: 降低敵方背包內所有精靈基礎能力值7%

otherTextQuestions.uncertainty: Base species stats or trained battle panel? Do all six actual reductions across the enemy team sum before the per-seven conversion? This materially changes the enormous bonus seen in previous logs.
otherTextQuestions.implementation: Uses trained calculatedStats and maxHp, sums reductions across the full team, then grants each own stat floor(total/7)*70.

otherTextQuestions.uncertainty: 15% of initial, maximum, or currently remaining energy? The following phrase 獲得150點能力 also does not identify whether 能力 means energy or combat stats.
otherTextQuestions.implementation: Text ambiguity identified; energy behavior not newly battle-tested in this audit.
